text:
Maya: Quick design review 1 - I'm prototyping a compact TOC and term-mapping layer inside the in-panel docs. Idea: small collapsible TOC at top + one-line term aliases under the header so users see both Console label + docs term. Goal: reduce confusion when search results use different words.

Chris: Nice. Small TOC will help discoverability. For aliases, can we auto-surface the most common alias and hide extras behind a "See variants" chevron? Keep UI minimal.

Sam: Agree on minimal UI. Implementation thought: docs manifest includes `aliases` and `preferred_label`. UI shows `preferred_label` and an overflow menu with other aliases. Example: `{"preferred_label":"Model routing","aliases":["routing","model-sharding"]}`.

Lee: Accessibility: TOC needs skip links and clear focus outlines when collapsed/expanded. The alias overflow must be keyboard reachable and announce its expanded state. Also ensure screen readers get the canonical term (aria-label) and the visual alternate is still readable.

Maya: Good catch @Lee. We'll add a visually-hidden canonical line for screen readers and include `aria-expanded` on the TOC toggle. Also the alias overflow will use a button with `aria-controls` to reveal the variants.

Nia: Marketing note: pick a single public-facing phrase for product docs links. Folks confused between "In-product docs" and "Help panel." We should keep "In-product docs" in UI and call it "Help panel" in support articles until we migrate.

Chris: We need mappings between Console routes and doc slugs for cross-linking. Docs team, can you export a CSV of `console_label,doc_slug,aliases,deprecated:boolean`? That will let the UI show a deprecation badge and wire redirects. @docs-bot

docs-bot: Scheduled export started. I'll post the CSV to #docs-api and create a permanent S3 export with versioning. Expect results within 24h.

Sam: About fallback behavior: if a doc is missing taxonomy/aliases, show the Console copy and add an inline feedback link "Report mismatch" that opens a tiny form (title + suggested label). We'll capture these in telemetry.

Maya: Cool. Telemetry plan: track TOC open rate, alias menu clicks, cross-link clicks, and mismatch reports. Canary to 5% for 72h with A/B test that shows aliases vs no aliases.

Lee: Microcopy suggestion: for the alias line use: "Also known as: <alias1>, <alias2>" and for deprecated: "Deprecated: last updated <date>" (dimmed, screen-reader friendly).

Chris: Minor UX nit: avoid showing long alias lists inline. Truncate after 2 and put "+3 more" menu.

Maya: I'll prototype the small TOC + alias affordance and share a Figma link tomorrow. Thanks all.

Nia: Thanks Maya, please include short copy options for the alias line (2 variants) so support/marketing can review.

Maya: Will do 1. Prototype ETA tomorrow AM.

docs-bot: Export queued. I'll also run a slug-stability report and flag docs without `preferred_label` or `aliases`.

Chris: :thumbsup:

Sam: :+1:
